description: Top listed tools by GateOnAI Score for one goal (e.g. writing, images, coding) or for one category. Without arguments you get the goals. Scores are GateOnAI's own method, not an industry standard.

category.description: Category slug instead of a goal, e.g. 'ai-agents'

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

name: get_best_for

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Get Top Tools for a Goal or Category
